changes.summary: From March 18 to June 28, 2026, the Musée des Arts Décoratifs presents Le langage des murs. Estampages de la Chine à Notre-Dame, the fourth focus exhibition in the Drawing, Wallpaper and Photography Department, coinciding with the Salon du Dessin and Printemps Asiatique. Featuring around one hundred works—including ancient and contemporary rubbings, drawings, and technical tools—the exhibition showcases the art of stone rubbing through a unique selection of the museum’s Chinese and French collections. On that occasion, the museum invites Santiago Hardy, a steepljack, and Delphine Syvilay, then research engineer at the Laboratory for Research on Historic Monuments (LRMH), to present for the first time the marks of the stonemasons and the stamped graffiti uncovered during the restoration of Notre-Dame de Paris.
